Makharij Al-Huruf - 17 Articulation Points of Arabic Letters

Makharij Al-Huruf means where Arabic letters come from in mouth and throat. 28 letters have 17 specific points in 5 main areas. Correct Makharij is foundation of Tajweed for USA & UK beginners.

📖 Free Makharij Chart: Get 17 points chart with tongue & throat diagram PDF. Claim Free Trial →

5 Main Areas of Makharij

  • 1. Al-Jauf (الجوف) - Empty space in mouth - 3 Madd letters: ا و ي
  • 2. Al-Halq (الحلق) - Throat - 6 letters: ء ه ع ح غ خ - Deep, Middle, Upper throat
  • 3. Al-Lisan (اللسان) - Tongue - 18 letters - Most letters from tongue
  • 4. Ash-Shafatan (الشفتان) - Lips - 4 letters: ف ب م و
  • 5. Al-Khayshoom (الخيشوم) - Nasal cavity - Ghunnah sound

Why Makharij Matters?

Small mistake in Makharij changes meaning: For example ح (Ha from throat) vs ه (Ha from mouth) - different letters!
